anomaly_label: Decreased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: System pressure stepped from ~500 mbar down to ~255 mbar and is now settling near 300 mbar, a setpoint change/upset rather than the steady 500 mbar of the first 10 minutes.
Transient spike to 18.6 mbar then collapse to ~0 and slightly negative (-0.4 to -0.1), unlike the stable 0.6 mbar baseline.
Reboiler temperature dropped 443 -> 323 °C then recovered to 426 °C, tracking the pressure excursion.
Overhead/condenser temperatures fell ~63 -> ~49 °C and are recovering to ~52 °C, consistent with the reduced column pressure.

args.missing_evidence: Confirmation of whether the pressure change to ~300 mbar was a commanded setpoint change in the protocol, plus a distillate composition measurement; also persistent near-zero/negative PDI701 suggests loss of column loading or a DP transmitter issue to be checked.
